title: AgentTaskContract
description: Schema defining a task specification within the Haven Art multi-agent system

title.description: Short descriptive title of the task

owner.description: Responsible agent role assigned to execute this task

reviewers.description: Reviewer agents responsible for evaluating acceptance

depends_on.description: IDs of tasks that must complete before this task starts

inputs.description: Artifacts, documents, or files consumed by this task

outputs.description: Artifacts, documents, or source code files produced by this task

acceptance.description: Specific, unambiguous criteria required to pass definition of done

tests.description: Test file paths or commands verifying this task

risk.description: Assessed risk level of task execution
